استقطعتا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَعَتَا (istaqṭaʕatā) /is.taq.tˤa.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اُسْتُقْطِعَتَا (ustuqṭiʕatā) /us.tuq.tˤi.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
